name: Shishibara Kaoru
source: A third-year at Ichijyoukan High School. He is called the Stride prodigy because he has been doing Stride ever since he was a child, and is pretty much unbeatable at it.
translation: A third-year at Ichijyoukan High School. He is called the Stride prodigy because he has been doing Stride ever since he was a child, and is pretty much unbeatable at it.
